comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1992 packs fifteen pool balls tightly on the foot spot and removes the triangle without disturbance.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate applies coordinated countertorque through concentric tools; PR-1992 compresses a group of free-rolling spheres, aligns the pack and lifts a surrounding frame cleanly.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades angle tolerance, nut seating, repeated-cycle retention and drift; PR-1992 grades ball-pair gaps, spot/orientation accuracy, rack clearance and displacement-free release. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Careful hands-off retention is shared only generically; packing and releasing rolling objects does not test threaded calibration under locknut reaction.
